exchanges: Hi. I just landed in Calgary and I'm sitting in my empty apartment eating crackers.
Welcome to Calgary. Crackers on the floor is a classic first night.
It is. The relocation package from Westbound covered the flight, at least.
That helps a lot. When do you start?
Next week. I'll be an analyst on the network planning team, mostly rail schedules.
That sounds like a good fit for someone who likes puzzles.
My cousin Imran is jealous. He's been learning Japanese for a year and wants me to move to Tokyo instead.
Ambitious of him. Is he planning to go himself?
Someday, he says. He's been saying that since high school.
Plans like that have a way of happening eventually.
My wrist is sore from carrying boxes. The physio back home said it's tendonitis and told me to rest it, which I have not done.
Moving is hard on the body. Try to give it a break this week.
My best friend Oluwaseun is getting married in August, so I need to book time off already.
Good to ask early at a new job.
It's in Banff, which is lucky, because that's now only an hour and a half away for me.
Very lucky. The mountains will make a beautiful setting.
Funny thing: one of the people on my new team is also called Imran. He speaks Swahili, he grew up partly in Mombasa.
Two of them will keep you on your toes.
I'll have to call them Imran One and Imran Two.
As long as neither of them hears the numbering.
The onboarding forms asked for my school, and I realized I haven't thought about Dalhousie in years.
Funny how the paperwork brings that back.
My Pixel is also dying. The battery barely lasts until lunch.
A new battery or a new phone might be worth it with all the planning apps.
My mom wants me to switch to an iPhone so we can video call more easily.
That is a common family request.
Correction on the wedding: Oluwaseun texted, it's September, not August. I had the date wrong.
Good thing you checked before asking for time off.
Yes, that would have been embarrassing. I'm also starting an accounting certificate at night, so my calendar is a mess.
That is a lot at once, but you can pace it.
The concierge downstairs, Rafael, helped me with the elevator. He's from Valparaiso and keeps telling me how much he misses the ocean.
Calgary is about as far from the ocean as it gets.
My manager Svetlana teaches a spin class every Saturday and has already invited me.
That is a friendly way to meet people outside work.
I'm not sure I'm ready to sweat in front of my boss.
Maybe once you have settled in.
Rafael has a little dog named Churro that sits at the front desk with him.
A desk dog is a great feature for a building.
The snow is already starting and it's barely October.
Winters here start early. Good boots will help.
What language did I say my cousin is learning?

earlier_question.right_reply: Your cousin Imran is learning Japanese.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your cousin Imran is learning Swahili.

questions.message: Which university did I go to?
What day is Svetlana's cycling session?
Which month is Oluwaseun's big day?
Oluwaseun's wedding is in Banff, isn't it?
What did Rafael call his pup?
I think I'll go out and buy a proper winter coat tomorrow.
What kind of phone does Svetlana use?
Did Rafael mention having any health problems?
Sorry, which language was my cousin studying?
